reason: Both native hosts acquired and built Skim and materialized the final-series plan, but the workflow still passed the stale v9 plan path to the independent auditor. Cache cleanup refused the installed Rust LLVM and rustc_driver binaries because they exceeded the initial 128 MiB per-file cap; this was a safe pre-removal refusal. No candidate case launched. V13 binds the auditor to the fresh plan namespace and allows files up to 1 GiB while preserving the 4 GiB total and 250000-file bounds. It reuses an existing pair of target-copy binaries only after verifying both against the exact build SHA-256.
